key.name: max-history-items
key.description: Maximum number of items to keep in clipboard history (text and images combined)

key.name: show-clipboard-popup
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to show clipboard popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the clipboard history popup window

key.name: private-mode
key.description: While enabled, nothing copied to the clipboard is saved to the history

key.name: toggle-private-mode
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to toggle private mode
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to turn private mode on or off (unset by default)

key.name: popup-theme
key.description: Color theme of the clipboard popup: follow the system style, light, dark, or a darker custom variant

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste when an item is selected
key.description: Paste the selected item into the focused window right away (sends Ctrl+V, or Ctrl+Shift+V in terminals)

key.name: clear-on-login
key.description: Remove history items (except bookmarks) when a new user session starts

key.name: close-on-outside-click
key.description: Grab pointer and keyboard while the popup is open, so a click outside it closes it (the click is not passed on)

key.name: last-session-id
key.description: Used to detect a new login
